production.role: Renderer orchestration, entity/organ label integration and cached real HUD exclusion rectangles.
Shared layout, battle-target/mother-core collectors and protected geometry.
Introductory ground / essential crisis separation, required crisis semantics and world-offset conversion.

tests.role: 17 recorder tests: archived real snapshots, actual Renderer call order, both quality modes, true pending-split/ordinary attacks, explicit synthetic guard/core variants; not native Canvas or player readability.
Pure layout and battle collector tests; this audit read their source and does not claim a new execution.
Pure squad/airway collector contracts; this audit read their source and does not claim a new execution.

resolvedFindings.problem: Old encounter label anchor+offset was a world-space translation before local glyph uncompression. Passing its y offset unchanged to the screen-space sink shifted its preferred baseline by .28*offset*scale.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Authorized helper now sends offset.y*.72 to SceneLabelSink. Real archived lung source/tissue caption tests compare Camera.worldToScreen(anchor)+offset*scale against the actual legacy Canvas baseline in both quality modes, before layout displacement.

resolvedFindings.problem: Pending split text formerly used landing.y-25 directly in the world transform. New uncompressed offset -25 moved it 7*scale CSS pixels upward.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Root changed it to -25*this.camera.yScale. This subagent added production sink collection and real landing projection tests; any final displaced label still retains the true landing anchor.

checks.evidence: Tissue/device/terminal/squad offsets originate inside local scale(1,1/.72), so raw local offset times camera.scale is correct. Core captions pass a fully specified world anchor, including their old world y offset, so projection is applied once. Lung phase passes its original world point. Encounter and split were the two world-offset cases needing the conversion above.

checks.result: no simulation write identified in reviewed diff
checks.evidence: Renderer labels/HUD copies, SceneLabels measurements/previous placements and GrowthVisuals trail histories are presentation-owned. Target sorting uses filtered arrays. Beacon/cell counts, flow timing and crisis read serialized fields. Latest scoped tests freeze complete original states and compare complete JSON after actual Renderer renders in normal/low modes; these tests do not execute gameplay.

checks.result: no newly invented hit/reveal fact identified
checks.evidence: GrowthVisuals.drawProtocolHits remains gated by acceptedProtocolHit and selectImmuneTraceCues; current hit/mark rendering logic is unchanged by its drawBeacon diff. Squad count is now restricted to the actual beacon, current organ and unexpired cells. Battle label hidden-MIMIC/reveal guards and focused weakness are covered by the separate collector tests; this review read those tests without treating fixture success as real play.

Renderer invokes ground guide before entities, then foreground/effects/marks/accepted hits, then crisis/ordinary/core danger, final labels in screen space. Ordinary targets retain serialized aim/radius/progress/X; a real hp=0 split mother retains both landing circles. Mother-core aim/radius/landings and sweep wall-clipped vertex logic remain in the actual production functions. Low effects does not remove the essential danger branch. Final native rendering and visual scrutiny remain separate.

Only playing/paused phases draw encounter cues. Paused current-organ charging renders the static geometry and 冲击暂停; blocked airway renders 截流暂停; arming/nextImpactAt=null renders 冲击暂停; exhausted keeps source/stop/root-cause text and omits the charging path/countdown. Elapsed state does not advance in these drawing functions. Missing/dead source, other organ and result phase produce no accepted crisis cues.

checks.result: intentional local caption culling; scope understood
checks.evidence: SceneLabels culls world anchors outside a96 CSSpx viewport margin, even for essential captions; it does not pull all distant organ information onto the current canvas. An archived lung impact snapshot has its tissue anchor offscreen, so the production layer-order test correctly uses an existing heart window snapshot with both anchors in view. The lung snapshot remains useful for isolated geometry/time semantics. Playing-state global crisis time/instructions remain encounterHudContent responsibility; paused overlay reports all timers paused. This is not proof that a distant lethal attack footprint intersects the viewport safely; final native screenshot matrix must still cover near-edge threats.

Shared collector reads actual flow.airwayOpen, changedAt, pressureUntil and CAMPAIGN_BALANCE costs/cooldown. Actual airway body, open/closed shapes and low-mode flow geometry remain. The pressure interval records the existing switch indication; toggleAirway applies its tissue cost immediately rather than scheduling hidden future damage.

checks.result: source-confirmed preservation; no new training run claimed
checks.evidence: Non-battle drawTarget still renders its original health/scanned training captions. drawTissue retains direct health bar and 03 repair captions when no battle. drawTerminal retains direct terminal name and near/playing E prompt; encounter/growth helpers return when no battle. Shared layout frame/reservations alone do not replace these legacy drawings.
